name: French-door refrigerator
notes: Rig: left-door, right-door hinge Y 0...110; freezer slide +Z 0...0.45. Option interior light on while either door > 5 deg (RigLight point). States: closed, left-open, right-open, both-open, freezer-open.
parts: brushed stainless doors with rounded edges and bar handles
interior liner with glass shelves, crisper bins and door bins
style: 2020s counter-depth French-door fridge, fingerprint smudges near handles
summary: French-door refrigerator, 36 in: stainless doors with bar handles, freezer drawer, lit interior with glass shelves and door bins.
